item.title: Eve Martin on Her Bid to Be the Next TCDSU Education Officer
item.description: “Ultimately we’re all here in College to get an education, so trying to improve that and make sure it is a functional system is something I want to do,” says Eve Martin, one of two candidates running for the role of Education Officer in this year’s Trinity College Dublin Students’ Union (TCDSU/AMLCT) elections. item.title: Harper Alderson Wants to Be Your Next University Times Editor
item.description: Harper Alderson is the only candidate running for Editor of the University Times (UT), the official newspaper of Trinity College Dublin. This means that she will win the election unless more people vote to re-open nominations (RON) than herself. She is the only candidate running uncontested in this year’s Students’ Union sabbatical elections. item.title: Graduate Officer Candidate Ava Tuohy Pledges to Represent Postgraduate Students and Encourage Engagement
item.description: Ava Tuohy is a final year postgraduate student completing a Higher Diploma degree in Psychology. She previously completed a BSc in Education Studies from Marino Institute of Education in 2024 and is now running for Graduate Officer at Trinity. While at Marino, Tuohy served as a class representative and worked as a student library assistant. item.title: Ents Candidate Finn Hallwood Wants You to Take up Space on Campus
item.description: The Trinity campus emanates a certain je ne sais quoi. Even the ugly bits (cough, Arts Block) play a central part in the daily lives of students and shape the experiences that come with getting that hard-earned Trinity degree. item.title: “I Do Everything I Can With Purpose, Watch Out For the Seagulls”: Féith Ní Chléirigh’s Bid for Graduate Officer
item.description: With Mitzy An Jiménez no longer running for the position, it is now a two-horse race for the freshly minted Graduate Sabbatical Officership. item.title: Sorcha O’Raghallaigh: The Irish designer behind Zara Larsson’s tour outfits
item.description: Sorcha O’Raghallaigh is the mastermind behind Zara Larsson’s standout fashion, according to a Dazed magazine article. O’Raghallaigh was born in County Offaly, Ireland, in the 1980s.
